what: Hovering over the slide panel hides the mouse arrow and a 70px-diameter white circle sticks right to the cursor position (no trailing lag). The circle appears from 1.2x and transparent to 1x over .5s. If the cursor is in the right half of the screen an accent-color arrow → shows, and in the left half it flips 180° into ← (rotation duration 0). Leaving the panel makes the circle swell to 1.2x on an overshoot curve over .3s and vanish. Clicking is handled by the previous and next buttons inside the panel

options.side: Decides the arrow direction by window (default, screen half as in the original) or area (panel half)
options.[data-fx-part=prev]·[data-fx-part=next]: (if present) press buttons covering the left and right halves of the plate — the motion part only handles the cursor shape, the buttons handle the flipping

note: On touch devices (no hover) nothing is attached. The original stalker only turns on at 1025px and up and while the Hero is visible

from.where: index.html .ma-hero__nav (hero video panel switcher — 70px white circle, 16px orange arrow, direction by screen half)
